QUANTUM VULNERABLE   Shor's algorithm breaks these outright

  RSA  (no call sites, 1 import)
    Shor's algorithm factors the modulus in polynomial time.
    migrate to: ML-KEM-768 for key establishment, ML-DSA-65 for signatures
      ciphers.py:13   from Crypto.PublicKey import RSA


ALREADY BROKEN       weak today, quantum is not the issue

  DES  (2 call sites, 2 imports)
    56-bit key. Brute-forced on commodity hardware.
    migrate to: AES-256-GCM
      ciphers.py:4   des = DES.new(b"8bytekey", DES.MODE_ECB)
      ciphers.py:15   renamed = SingleDES.new(b"8bytekey", SingleDES.MODE_ECB)
      ciphers.py:1   from Crypto.Cipher import AES, ARC4, DES, DES3
      ... and 1 more

  MD5  (2 call sites, 2 imports)
    Collisions are practical today. Quantum is not the problem here.
    migrate to: SHA-256 or SHA-3, or BLAKE2 for non-compliance use
      ciphers.py:8   md5 = MD5.new(b"data")
      ciphers.py:16   digest = md5_new(b"data")
      ciphers.py:2   from Crypto.Hash import MD5, SHA1
      ... and 1 more

  3DES  (1 call site, 1 import)
    Sweet32 birthday attacks. Disallowed by NIST for encryption after 2023.
    migrate to: AES-256-GCM
      ciphers.py:5   tdes = DES3.new(b"0123456789abcdef01234567", DES3.MODE_CBC)
      ciphers.py:1   from Crypto.Cipher import AES, ARC4, DES, DES3

  RC4  (1 call site, 1 import)
    Biased keystream. Prohibited in TLS since RFC 7465.
    migrate to: AES-256-GCM or ChaCha20-Poly1305
      ciphers.py:6   rc4 = ARC4.new(b"key")
      ciphers.py:1   from Crypto.Cipher import AES, ARC4, DES, DES3

  SHA-1  (1 call site, 1 import)
    Chosen-prefix collisions demonstrated in 2020. Retire it.
    migrate to: SHA-256 or SHA-3
      ciphers.py:9   sha1 = SHA1.new(b"data")
      ciphers.py:2   from Crypto.Hash import MD5, SHA1


REVIEW               reduced margin under Grover, usually acceptable

  AES  (1 call site, 1 import)
    Grover halves effective key length. AES-256 stays at 128-bit margin.
    migrate to: AES-256 if currently AES-128
      ciphers.py:7   aes = AES.new(b"0123456789abcdef", AES.MODE_GCM)
      ciphers.py:1   from Crypto.Cipher import AES, ARC4, DES, DES3
